name: Premium Amount 3
definition: Commercial agreement in which the buyer agrees to pay the seller an amount of cash. Some aspects of the payment may be defined in the agreement, for example, the method of the payment.

PremiumQuote.name: Premium Quote
PremiumQuote.definition: Specifies the calculation method of the premium amount.

PremiumCurrency.name: Premium Currency
PremiumCurrency.definition: Identification of the premium currency in which the option is held.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Result of the calculation of the premium amount on the basis of the premium quote and one of the amounts of the underlying foreign exchange trade.

DecimalPlaces.name: Decimal Places
DecimalPlaces.definition: Number of decimal places to which quantities of units/shares are rounded.

PremiumSettlementDate.name: Premium Settlement Date
PremiumSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the premium must be settled.
